abilities.effect: The runes unleash a gout of fire roaring up the chute. Anyone in the chute and within 5 feet of its openings is dealt 8d10+44 fire damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save). Immediately thereafter, the runes emanate a 4th-level *silence* effect for 1 minute, so anyone injured in the chute can't call out for help.
abilities.name: Explosion

hazard.description: Nearly imperceptible runes set off an explosion at the point a thief is most unable to receive aid.
hazard.disable: DC 45 Thievery (master) or *dispel magic* (10th level, counteract DC 50) to counteract the runes
hazard.name: Thief's Trap

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to notice that the hairline cracks on the passage walls actually form runes.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
